Five minutes from now, you could have a link to send

5-Minute Site Bot turns a short description into a fully built website — design, copy and hosting all handled — and sends you back a working link. Under five minutes. No code, no designer, no waiting room.

Start your site

What this is

You already know you need a website. What you don't need is the month of emails, quotes and revisions that usually comes with one.

5-Minute Site Bot is a bot that lives in Telegram, right next to the chats you already have open. You tell it, in ordinary sentences, what your business does and who it's for. It takes that description and builds a complete website around it — the pages, the layout, the words, the look — and puts it online for you. When it's done, it hands you a live hosted link you can share anywhere: with customers, on your social profiles, in your email signature.

It's built for people who don't have time to become web designers. The plumber who needs somewhere to point customers. The baker taking orders for the weekend. Someone with a side project they've been meaning to put online "eventually" for a year. If you can describe your business to a neighbour, you can brief this bot — because that's exactly the level of detail it asks for.

The way you work with it is the way you'd work with a very fast, very literal assistant. You send messages. It asks short follow-up questions when something's unclear. You answer in plain language, and it gets on with the work. There's no account dashboard to learn, no software to install, no terminology to decode. Everything happens inside a conversation you're already comfortable having.

And the whole thing runs on one promise: speed without shortcuts. Five minutes is enough time to make tea, not enough time to lose momentum — which is precisely why most websites never get made. This one does.

See what you get

What the bot does for you

Two things, both finished before your coffee goes cold.

Website creation via Telegram bot

Ready in 5 minutes. Send a short description of your business and the bot builds the entire site from it — structure, written content and design decisions included. You don't pick templates, drag blocks or touch a single line of code. You answer questions like "what do you do?" and "who is it for?", and the site comes out the other end looking like someone competent spent an afternoon on it.

Instant hosted link delivery

A website nobody can visit isn't a website. The moment yours is built, the bot gives you a live hosted link — a real address on the internet, ready to paste into your Instagram bio, WhatsApp status, business cards or anywhere else customers might look. No setting up hosting, no buying a server, no technical setup between "finished" and "online."

Brief the bot now

How it works

Four steps. You've probably already done step one without noticing — you're reading a website right now.

01

Open Telegram

Find 5-Minute Site Bot in Telegram and start a chat. If you have the app installed, you're one search away from beginning.

02

Describe your site

Tell the bot what you do, who it's for, and what you want people to do when they land on the page. Plain words are perfect — it was built for them.

03

Watch it build

The bot turns your description into a complete website: pages laid out, text written, colours and typography chosen. No input needed from you while it works.

04

Share your link

You get a live hosted link for your finished site. Copy it, send it, post it. Your business is officially on the internet.

Questions people ask first

If yours isn't here, just ask the bot — it answers faster than this page does.

Do I need to know how to code or design?
No, genuinely neither. The bot handles all the technical and design work itself. Your job is to describe your business clearly, which you already do every day — to customers, suppliers, friends. If you can send a text message, you can run this bot.
What exactly do I send the bot?
A few sentences about your business: what you do, who your customers are, and what you'd like visitors to know or do. The bot may ask a couple of quick follow-up questions to fill in gaps. Nothing formal, no documents, no preparation needed.
Is "five minutes" realistic or marketing?
It's the whole point. Because you're not reviewing drafts, attending calls or choosing between forty templates, the time between "here's my idea" and "here's my link" is genuinely measured in minutes, not days. Send your description, watch it work, collect your link.
What kinds of websites can it build?
The kind most people actually need: a clean, complete site that explains a business or project and tells visitors how to reach it — a home for your trade, shop, service, portfolio or side project. Describe what you need and the bot builds to fit.
What do I walk away with?
A fully built website and a live hosted link to it. Not a preview, not a mockup, not a "coming soon" page — a real site on the internet that anyone you send the link to can open immediately.
Why a bot instead of a web designer?
Different tools for different jobs. A designer is worth it for complex custom projects. But if what you need is a good-looking, working site up today — not eventually — the bot removes every delay between knowing you need a website and actually having one.

Starting is one message away

There's no form to fill in here and no inbox to wait on — because there doesn't need to be. The bot lives where you already are.

To get started, open Telegram and search for 5-Minute Site Bot. Start a chat and send a couple of lines about what you need — what you do, who it's for. That's the entire sign-up process. No account creation, no downloads beyond an app you likely already have, no credit screen standing between you and your website.

If you're reading this on your phone, you're closer than you think: the whole thing — briefing, building, link in hand — can happen before you put the kettle on again.

  • First message Two or three lines about your business
  • Then Answer its quick questions and watch it build
